children: MicroPort Scientific has appointed Jonathan W. Chen as chief executive officer and said Zhaohua Chang has resigned as a company director, according to a filing to the Hong Kong stock exchange on Sunday.
Chen was appointed executive director, chief executive officer and authorised representative of the medical devices manufacturer, effective October 22
MicroPort said Chen would lead its day-to-day management and report directly to the board
The company said it would review its governance structure, implement a CEO-led management structure and establish a President's Office to assist the CEO
Chang resigned as director and from related positions due to "other personal commitments", the company said
He will remain MicroPort's chief scientific officer and said he had no disagreement with the board, according to the filing
